general.text: Tell me about yourself and what brought you to this point in your career.
Walk me through your background and what you consider your greatest professional strength.
Introduce yourself and describe what you are most proud of professionally.
Tell me about a time you had to explain a complex idea to someone unfamiliar with the topic.
Describe a situation where clear communication made a significant difference in an outcome.
Give an example of when you had to deliver difficult news or feedback to someone.
Describe a difficult problem you solved. What was your approach?
Tell me about a challenge you faced and the steps you took to overcome it.
Describe a time when you had to make a decision with incomplete information. What did you do?
Tell me about a time you had to work with someone whose style or opinion differed greatly from yours.
Describe a situation where you had to quickly adapt to an unexpected change.
Tell me about a time you had to take on a role or task that was outside your comfort zone.
What is one area you are actively working to improve, and what are you doing about it?
What motivates you most in your work, and how does that show up day-to-day?
Describe a moment when you received critical feedback and how you responded to it.
